title: 5,000 security troops fielded for Undas in Zamboanga Peninsula

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — The Police Regional Office 9 (PRO-9) has deployed over 5,000 security personnel and force multipliers across the Zamboanga Peninsula and Sulu province to ensure a peaceful, orderly observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day (Undas 2026). Police Brig. Gen. Elmer Ragay, PRO-9 Director, directed the region’s police forces to heighten visibility, establish strategic checkpoints, and intensify public safety operations throughout the holiday period. Police Lt. Col. Shellamie Chang, Chief of the PRO-9 Regional Public Information Office, said 5,355 security forces have been mobilized to secure 241 cemeteries, memorial parks, and columbaria across the […]...
